note: dsim position-target vehicle, ideal pose, no wind, <=50 ms telemetry latency. Stops by HOLD before each corner/endpoint; never by converging on a target.

calibration.vehicle: dsim DroneSimulator via DsimLink loopback, fixed 0.05 s step; HOLD zeroes commanded and actual velocity immediately
calibration.limits: No wind was measured, so none is supported: dsim HOLD does not hold position against wind. Position-target overshoot (0.62 m) exceeds stopping_m, which is why the executor stops by HOLD before targets. Real vehicles decelerate; these numbers do not transfer.
